## Change

What problem does this solve, and what will users see?

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Say whether Steam was mocked or tested manually; do not include real account details.

- [ ] Changed Go files are formatted.
- [ ] Tests and `go vet` pass, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] Relevant usage documentation is updated.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, cached sessions or active QR images are included.
- [ ] Dependency changes include reviewed `go.mod` / `go.sum` and license updates, if applicable.
